 SSC has released the JE 2026 Paper 1 exam city intimation slip. Check how to download city details, exam dates, admit card updates and important deadlines at ssc.gov.in. 
 MC Education Desk 
 October 24, 2026 / 12:18 IST Share --> 
 --> 
 --> 
 --> 
 SSC JE 2026 Exam City Intimation Slip Released for Paper 1 @ ssc.gov.in, Check Download Steps and Exam Dates SSC JE Paper 1 exam city details are now released.
 Paper 1 is scheduled to be held from Nov 2 to 6, 2026.
 Deadline for scribe and subject changes is Oct 27.

 The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released the examination city details for the Junior Engineer (JE) Examination 2026 Paper 1. Candidates who have registered for the recruitment examination can check their allotted exam city by logging in to the official website, ssc.gov.in.
 The SSC JE Paper 1 examination is scheduled to be held from November 2 to 6, 2026. Candidates should check their examination city details in advance to plan their travel and make the necessary arrangements before the test.
 The examination city intimation slip and the admission certificate, commonly known as the admit card, are separate documents. According to the information provided, the admission certificate is expected to be available for download two to three days before the candidate's examination date.
 SSC JE 2026: Important Dates 
 Candidates appearing for the SSC Junior Engineer examination should keep the following dates in mind.
 Event Date 
 SSC JE Paper 1 Examination November 2 to 6, 2026 
 JE (Telecommunication Engineering) Examination November 30 to December 1, 2026 
 Fresh Own-Scribe Registration Deadline October 27, 2026, at 11 pm 
 Subject Preference Change Deadline October 27, 2026, at 11 pm 
 SSC JE Paper 1 Admission Certificate Expected 2 to 3 days before the examination 
 The examination city details for JE (Telecommunication Engineering) are expected to be released around eight to 10 days before the examination.
 How to Download the SSC JE 2026 Exam City Intimation Slip 
 Candidates can check their SSC JE Paper 1 exam city by following these steps:
 Visit the official SSC website at ssc.gov.in .
 Log in using the required credentials.
 Open the designated login module for the Junior Engineer Examination 2026.
 Locate the examination city details on the dashboard.
 Check the allotted examination city and save the information for future reference.
 Candidates should rely on the official SSC portal for their examination details and any further announcements.
 SSC JE 2026 Admit Card: When Will It Be Released? 
 The examination city intimation slip provides information about the city where a candidate's examination will be held. It is not a substitute for the admission certificate or admit card.
 The SSC JE 2026 Paper 1 admission certificate is expected to be released two to three days before the respective examination date. Candidates should regularly check the official website for the download link and follow the instructions mentioned on the certificate.
 SSC JE 2026: Own-Scribe Registration Deadline 
 SSC has issued additional instructions for candidates who opted to use their own scribe during the examination. Under the revised process, eligible candidates may need to register their scribes again on the SSC website. The commission has integrated scribe registration with Aadhaar authentication, making fresh registration necessary for candidates covered by the new instructions.
 The deadline to complete fresh registration and map the scribe's One-Time Registration (OTR) is October 27, 2026, at 11 pm. Candidates intending to use the facility should complete the process before the deadline. As per the instructions provided, only candidates who successfully map their scribe's OTR will be able to use the facility.
 SSC JE 2026: Subject Preference Change Deadline 
 The commission has also issued instructions for candidates who applied for JE (Telecommunication Engineering) and were eligible for the Scientific Assistant (SA) post.
 Candidates who selected Scientific Assistant as their default subject may choose Electrical and Telecommunication (EC/TC) as the default subject. Those wishing to change their subject preference to Computer Science and Information Technology (CS/IT) or Physics can do so through the city selection option.
 The deadline for making these changes is October 27, 2026, at 11 pm. No further changes will be permitted after the deadline, according to the information provided. Candidates must appear for the subject specified on their admission certificate. They should review their selection carefully and check the relevant SSC notice before making any changes.
 SSC JE 2026: What Candidates Should Do Next 
 Candidates appearing for Paper 1 should check their examination city details, keep track of the admit card release and review the instructions applicable to their examination. Those using the own-scribe facility or seeking to change their subject preference should complete the required steps by October 27, 2026, at 11 pm, wherever applicable.
 For the latest updates, examination notices and admission certificates, candidates should visit the official Staff Selection Commission website.
